ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown, it is known that $ \triangle ABD \cong \triangle ACE$, $ \angle A=53^\circ$, $ \angle B=22^\circ$. Then, how many degrees is $ \angle AEC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $\triangle ABD \cong \triangle ACE$,\\
it follows that $\angle C = \angle B = 22^\circ$,\\
therefore, in $\triangle AEC$, $\angle AEC = 180^\circ - \angle A - \angle C = 180^\circ - 53^\circ - 22^\circ = \boxed{105^\circ}$.
